review.scientific: Internal review of original teaching prose, pressure and flow definitions, Poiseuille derivation, Reynolds boundary conditions, red-cell flux conservation, RC derivation, classical and revised Starling distinctions, all 52 keys and explanations; recomputed representative numerical values independently. Corrected transmural pressure arrow and clarified transvascular arrows represent forces. Verified references by indexed records/accessible source material; no external peer review.
review.editorial: Distinct internal editorial pass: checked 13-section progression, headings, coherent mechanisms, 148 unique teaching paragraphs, question order, revision, captions, 15 accessible SVGs, zoom controls, template preservation, cross-link and dynamic navigation; added explicit pressure/compliance and capillary architecture figures. Static checks repeated on final blob.

score_basis: Internal static review: deduct 1 for limited full-text verification, 1 for no browser-rendered SVG inspection, 1 for limited distractor detail and graph-question variety, 1 for untested interactive/keyboard reader behavior, 1 for untested responsive rendering and predeployment live tests.
